critical_code_review_comments: ParentHome.jsx now correctly refetches sched on activeChildId change; the pattern (5th Promise inside Promise.all + null-safe .catch) matches ParentPay.jsx — no divergence.

The upcoming-row testid uses `m.month` (numeric like '4','5','7','8'), while StudentDetail Monthly tab uses `m.index`. Not a bug, but standardising on `m.index` across the app would be less confusing (index is 0-based position; month is 1-12 numeric).

Cleanup: dead `sched` state was the same class of bug flagged in iter12 code review — worth a smoke test that asserts non-empty Upcoming Fees card when at least one pending month exists in the schedule.
